Suvarna Projects Limited 
 Office of the Executive Engineer · Madhya Pradesh · IN 
 
 No. CC/29/2012/005 
 Dated: 31/03/2026 
 
 CERTIFICATE OF COMPLETION OF WORK 
 This is to certify that the work of "Substation EPC - Madhya Pradesh Pkg-5" (industrial epc),
 awarded to M/s National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. (GSTIN 19NAICC4417O1Z1, PAN NAICC4417O) ,
 has been completed in all respects on 26/04/2012 at a gross executed value of Rs. 2441.00 Lakh
 (Rupees 24.41 Crore Only). 
 
 On joint measurement and final inspection, the executed quantities were found in order and the
 workmanship conforming to the technical specifications forming part of the contract.
 The work was supervised on the contractor's side by Meera Banerjee. This certificate is issued for
 record and for submission with future tenders wherever the contractor is required to establish past
 performance. 
 
 
 
 Executive Engineer 
 Suvarna Projects Limited
